reviewFindings: high: controller.py:440-446 then 457 - blocking close()+wait_closed() for STT and every TTS session runs BEFORE stop_capture() on each monitor restart (save/load/pause/resume), so capture keeps filling the 250 ms Qt buffer during GUI stalls >250 ms -> mic audio dropped at every restart boundary

high: audio.py:336 + constants.py:28-33 - the 250 ms QAudioSource buffer is the documented overflow point; truncation worsens as per-utterance GUI work (blocking teardown, JSON save at controller.py:609, per-frame resample+Silero, streaming-TTS fan-out at controller.py:530-531/592-593) accumulates

medium: controller.py:493-496 - VAD reset on every chunk during TRANSCRIBING/SYNTHESIZING/SPEAKING discards barge-in speech and the pre-roll; a hung STT server leaves state stuck in TRANSCRIBING with the VAD permanently reset (no timeout in the path)

medium: controller.py:190-194/298-311/385-391 - save while LISTENING closes the in-flight STT session (utterance lost); every restart starts a fresh VAD with empty pre-roll so speech begun in the restart window loses ~128 ms trigger + up to 600 ms lead-in
low: vad.py:546-547 with maxlen vad.py:458/461 - mid-utterance pauses >480 ms permanently evict older silence frames (silence-only, bounded, verified)
low: vad.py:587-592 - set_stop_silence_frames does not resize _speech_resume_buffer_frames (fixed at construction), so raising the hangover does not grow pause retention
info: vad.py:598 - reset() clears _pending_bytes (<1 frame, <=32 ms) at utterance boundaries; bounded, negligible
info: controller.py:545 - _synthesis_sessions replaced without close(); benign in normal flow (sessions complete before IDLE) but leaves daemon threads/sockets alive if a server hangs
cleared: no double-consume of audio anywhere (readAll removal semantics, idempotent stop_capture, exclusive VAD buffer paths, generation guards)
cleared: no cumulative drift from 250 ms buffer + frame-count VAD (byte-exact accumulator, per-frame exact resample to 512 detector samples)
